headline: Sener projects investment of 61,000 million dollars in electricity by 2030
summary: Mexico's energy ministry (Sener) projects $61 billion of electricity investment through 2030. The plan adds 10,475 circuit kilometers, a 10% increase, to the national transmission grid.
why: Electricity transmission investment in Mexico involves state utility CFE and private developers, affecting construction, equipment and renewable power demand. Grid capacity is a key constraint on energy projects.
original_headline: Proyecta Sener inversión de 61,000 millones de dólares en electricidad al 2030
